closed_findings: Ownership loss now forbids signalling; default SIGCHLD, single-owner and WNOWAIT capability are checked before launch.

Process-group signal and leader reap each occur at most once. Every first signal confirms held child ownership. No signal follows any reap attempt; uncertain cleanup never returns an admitted exited result.
Expired or nonfinite request budget refuses before Popen. Monotonic bounds and bounded stdout/stderr prefixes are retained, with observed byte counts and terminal output-limit status.
Complete event/item/usage allowlists reject tools, unknown schemas, duplicate JSON keys and malformed usage. Registered startup warnings are exact, pre-turn only and multiplicity-bounded.

Observed usage is distinct from complete request usage. Post-transport write failure and transport-not-returned paths retain confirmed/indeterminate launches and any observed usage; incomplete total remains null.
Source, pilot, protocol, CLI and tool bytes are checked against the freeze before/after generation, after native evaluation and before qualification eligibility is issued.
Model cwd is a new directory outside source/evidence trees. Hidden evaluation is terminal for the cell, including failure; no hidden result enters a repair request.
decision_scope: Only the exact freeze-02 prospective pilot; root must separately authorize START after both independent reviews and required registration.
evidence_write_policy: New run/attempt directories and raw files use exclusive creation; mutable progress JSON checkpoints intentionally use atomic replacement inside the newly owned directory. Earlier superseded freeze and controls remain preserved.
limits: This review and the 19 human-reference/19 dummy controls do not establish model qualification or success. Fresh three-of-three qualification remains required before the 16-cell main stage.
CLI/source hashes are local byte observations under the stated trusted-host scope; they are not provider weight attestation, a transitive toolchain closure proof or a malicious-host sandbox.
Configuration, rules and hooks are retained. Absence of observed tool events does not prove inability to access files.
Token bounds are checked on actual reported usage after execution. No pre-generation provider token-cap or old V9 capacity proof is claimed; unknown bootstrap/service cost remains disclosed.
